{{Top|leg}}
The '''Peoples' Advisor''' was a position on the [[Royal Court]] of [[Virujansi/Legends|Virujansi]]. Due to protocol, the [[Rajah]] was not meant to listen directly to a supplicant before him; as a result, the Peoples' Advisor interpreted and translated the visitor's words for the Rajah.
